{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|If you deliver a datadot to a certain Mon Calamari who will be in Mos Eisley for the next few days, the credits are yours.|[[Barid Mesoriaam]], to [[Kabe/Legends|Kabe]]|<ref name="Tales">{{StoryCite|story=Play It Again, Figrin D'an: The Tale of Muftak and Kabe|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>}}
A '''datadot''' was a device used for storing and transporting information. It was shaped like a small, [[Color/Legends|black]] circle<ref name="Tales" /> that was less than a [[Millimeter/Legends|millimeter]] in diameter. Information from datadots could be read by [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]] such as the [[CS-Mark 12 holoprojector]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
